item.title: Suriya-Starrer 'Scene' Trailer Released With Political References

item.description: Demonstrators engaged in physical altercations with law enforcement as massive crowds gathered across 34 German urban centers.

item.title: ফরাসি শহরে বিক্ষোভ চলাকালে সহিংসতা, পাঁচশতাধিক আটক
item.description: ফ্রান্সে বিক্ষোভ চলাকালীন সংঘাতে জড়িয়ে পড়েন আন্দোলনকারীরা। এই ঘটনায় পাঁচশোর বেশি মানুষকে আটক করা হয়েছে এবং সাধারণ মানুষের আর্থিক কষ্টের কথা তুলে ধরেছেন এক বিক্ষোভকারী।

item.title: Hamilton secures pole position for Ferrari as Antonelli faces F1 weekend
item.description: Lewis Hamilton claimed his inaugural pole position for Ferrari during a weekend where young driver Kimi Antonelli aims for the Formula 1 world championship.

item.title: Morning briefing: INDIA bloc plans Delhi march and UK considers slavery apology
item.description: Key updates include the INDIA alliance organizing a march toward Delhi directed at the CEC and SIR, alongside the UK Prime Minister indicating a willingness to apologize for slavery.

item.title: Indian Opposition Plans Large Protest to Demand Election Chief Quit
item.description: Opposition parties in India are organizing a major demonstration demanding the resignation of the chief election official. This action follows widespread demonstrations regarding voter list updates that critics worry could exclude 130 million citizens.

item.title: টিভিতে আজকের খেলাধুলা (১ নভেম্বর ২০২৬)
item.description: ১ নভেম্বর ২০২৬ তারিখে নিউজিল্যান্ড-ভারত পঞ্চম টি-টোয়েন্টি, লিভারপুল-আর্সেনাল ম্যাচ এবং রিয়াল মাদ্রিদের খেলা টেলিভিশনে দেখা যাবে। এছাড়া সকাল সাড়ে নয়টায় জাতীয় ক্রিকেট লিগের বিভিন্ন ম্যাচ শুরু হবে।

item.title: Vishwak Sen Starrer Telugu Film Cult Sees Strong Box Office Jump
item.description: Telugu movie Cult, starring Vishwak Sen, experienced a significant financial boost with Saturday earnings more than doubling its second-day figures. Exhibited across 1,211 locations, the picture reached a cumulative net of Rs 2.90 crore.

item.title: Examining the Clashes Behind the Naga-Kuki Ethnic Strife in Manipur
item.description: Security forces from the CRPF and BSF were deployed to maintain separation between the Naga and Kuki populations in Manipur. This intervention followed violent altercations between the two groups in the region.

item.title: Glenn Phillips Nears International T20 Record Ahead of India Match
item.description: New Zealand batsman Glenn Phillips requires 56 more runs in the upcoming game against India to set a new global record. He currently has 276 runs in the series, featuring a 49-ball century scored on Friday.

item.title: India A Faces Trouble Breaking Foxcroft and Boyle Stand in Match
item.description: During the fixture between India A and New Zealand A, the bowling side faced difficulties ending the partnership between Foxcroft and Boyle. This resistance occurred after India A managed early breakthroughs.

item.title: Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 Reaches Rs 33.95 Crore Worldwide
item.description: The movie Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 earned Rs 33.95 crore worldwide within its first two days in theaters. Domestic ticket sales also saw an increase on Saturday, October 31, bringing in Rs 10.40 crore.

item.title: Iran and Qatar Discuss Proposal to Open Strait of Hormuz in Two Days
item.description: Iran's senior diplomat stated that discussions are underway with Qatar regarding a 48-hour plan to reactivate the Strait of Hormuz. The reopening depends on the United States accepting specific terms set by Tehran.

item.title: Nepal Prime Minister expected to make official trip to India near end of November
item.description: Indian Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri is laying the groundwork for Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah's anticipated trip to India towards the end of November. The head of government has seldom traveled internationally since assuming office in March.

item.title: How buying a 3D printer can reduce costs for five pricey pastimes
item.description: Purchasing a 3D printing device requires a significant initial expenditure. However, using one can lower overall costs for people who regularly participate in five high-cost hobbies.

item.title: Indian diplomatic chief advocates for varied supply routes at G20 gathering
item.description: At the G20 conference, India's External Affairs Minister cautioned that manipulating energy distribution for political purposes creates negative outcomes. The minister urged international delegates to build more varied supply networks to mitigate these risks.

item.title: Pundits scrutinize Lisandro Martinez following dismissal in Manchester United loss
item.description: Sports commentators Danny Murphy and Stephan Warnock evaluated Lisandro Martinez's contribution on Match of the Day following Manchester United's two-goal defeat against Chelsea. The Argentinian defender received a red card during the match.

item.title: Video records Chicago immigration officer forcefully pushing educator blocking vehicle
item.description: A bystander filmed an officer from Immigration and Customs Enforcement aggressively knocking down an educator in Chicago. The incident occurred while the woman was preventing the agent's automobile from proceeding.

item.title: US deliberates on potential strikes as Iranian leadership issues warning
item.description: American official Rubio indicated that the United States has not determined whether to conduct fresh military strikes against Iran. Meanwhile, Iran's top religious authority cautioned both America and Israel on October 31, 2026, against initiating further aggression.

item.title: যৌথ সরকার গঠনের দাবিতে ইসরায়েলে বিপুল সংখ্যক মানুষের বিক্ষোভ
item.description: ইসরায়েলে যৌথভাবে ইহুদি ও আরবদের সরকার গড়ার দাবিতে রাজপথে বিশাল প্রতিবাদ সভা অনুষ্ঠিত হয়েছে। বিক্ষোভকারীরা বর্ণবাদ বিরোধিতা ও পারস্পরিক সম্প্রীতির আহ্বানে সোচ্চার হন। তারা উল্লেখ করেন যে দুই সম্প্রদায় একে অপরের বিপরীতে অবস্থান নিতে অনিচ্ছুক।

item.title: Poor early-season form places Manchester United's final points tally in question
item.description: Manchester United has secured merely nine points throughout their opening seven matches this season. Should the club maintain this exact scoring pace across all fixtures, they would fail to reach thirty points by the end of the campaign.

item.title: Ranabaali Reaches Rs 79.58 Crore in Global Ticket Sales
item.description: On its sixteenth day, the Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna movie collected Rs 42.55 lakh domestically. This brought its total domestic net to Rs 57.89 crore and worldwide gross to Rs 79.58 crore.

item.title: Prime Minister Modi Criticizes Opposition at Unity Event
item.description: During a Unity Day commemoration for Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, PM Modi blamed rival political groups for blocking progress and plotting national division.

item.title: Driver Ocon Rejects Claims of Physical Fight Before Exit
item.description: Esteban Ocon dismissed claims that his removal by Haas at the Mexico City event stemmed from a physical argument with team boss Ayao Komatsu.
